item.title: Turkish, UAE presidents discuss expanding, strengthening ties in phone call
item.description: The two leaders discuss cooperation opportunities and steps to further strengthen bilateral ties in line with their common interests and shared benefits.

item.title: Palestine welcomes African Union's support for its bid for full UN membership
item.description: AU concludes its 39th summit calling for full UN membership for Palestine and rejects Israel's forced displacement plans.

item.title: Iran urges US to negotiate independently of Israeli influence in nuclear talks
item.description: Tehran says it remains open to talks over its nuclear programme, accusing Israel of attempting to sabotage the process.

item.title: Over 20,000 Gaza patients await evacuation as Israel continues to restrict Rafah crossing
item.description: Israel's partial reopening of border crossing with Egypt fails to meet humanitarian needs, Palestinian health officials warn.

item.title: Israel's West Bank 'state property' move is legally void: Palestine
item.description: Palestinian Foreign Ministry calls for urgent international action to halt illegal Israeli annexation and protect the two-state solution.

item.title: Japan rebukes China over accusations of reviving militarism
item.description: Japan protested after China’s Wang Yi accused it of reviving militarism at the Munich Security Conference.

item.title: Deadly fireworks blast rocks China ahead of Lunar New Year
item.description: The Lunar New Year, also known as China’s Spring Festival, falls on Tuesday, when people traditionally set off firecrackers at midnight to welcome the new year.

item.title: Nepal kicks off election campaign months after deadly protests ousted government
item.description: Around 300,000 security personnel are deployed as candidates campaign for March elections held early after September’s deadly protests and political upheaval.

item.title: Power cuts, travel disruption as fierce storm strikes New Zealand
item.description: Severe storms battered New Zealand’s North Island, grounding flights, closing roads and cutting power to more than 30,000 properties as emergency crews responded to widespread flooding and damage.
